in_marathi.name: Deepiksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp in deep water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepiksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deepiksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning 'lamp' and 'Ksh' meaning 'in deep water'. This name signifies the light that shines brightly even in the darkest of situations. It is a name of strength and resilience, symbolizing the ability to overcome challenges and emerge victorious.
